missing_ops.need: circle fit to an XLD contour that returns (row, col, radius) — HALCON fit_circle_contour_xld
missing_ops.why: hx_fit_circle_contour returns only the RMS residual and hx_smallest_circle_xld a centroid-centred enclosing radius divided by max(H, W); the radius of a round part had to be read from elliptic_axis_xld (Ra = Rb) instead

missing_ops.need: watershed that returns the basins (one region / label per object) — HALCON watersheds 'Basins'
missing_ops.why: watersheds, pouring, xcv_watershed_markers and sg_watershed_gradient return only the dam lines; counting their components gives 1-4 for 4 / 6 touching disks, so splitting touching parts stops at the marker step (distance transform + h-maxima) and the split parts cannot be measured one by one

missing_ops.need: dominant spatial frequency / period of an image as a feature (strongest non-DC FFT peak: cycles/px and angle)
missing_ops.why: fft_image / power_real / power_ln return spectrum images; the max-projection profile's argmax lands on the DC column and tb_find_peaks returns ~30 noise peaks, so no chain reads the grating period from the spectrum (the texture period recipe goes through zero crossings of a profile instead)

missing_ops.need: bar-code / 2-D code decoding (symbology + data string) — HALCON find_bar_code / find_data_code_2d
missing_ops.why: decode_barcode only counts dark bars on the centre scan line; no op returns the encoded data

missing_ops.need: OCR character classification (HALCON do_ocr_single_class_mlp / read text)
missing_ops.why: the 2-D family can segment glyphs (hx_char_threshold, sk_sauvola) but nothing classifies them

missing_ops.need: polar unwrap about a given centre and radius range — HALCON polar_trans_image_ext with Row/Column/Radius
missing_ops.why: polar_trans_image(_ext) always use the image centre and min(H, W)/2; an off-centre ring / bore cannot be unwrapped after locating it with area_center (the ring recipe needs the ring at the image centre)

missing_ops.need: take the SWT field (matrix) out of swt_map's table, or a text_candidates that accepts swt_map's dict
missing_ops.why: swt_map -> table and text_candidates(matrix) do not connect; the detector pipeline swt -> candidates -> lines cannot be chained

missing_ops.need: split vx_sobel3x3's {gx, gy} table into two S16 images (or a vx_sobel_magnitude)
missing_ops.why: vx_magnitude / vx_phase take two image2d, vx_sobel3x3 returns one table: the OpenVX gradient graph Sobel -> Magnitude -> NonMax cannot be chained

missing_ops.need: dominant wavelength (peak) of surface_psd's (frequency, PSD) pairs
missing_ops.why: feed-mark wavelength from an areal PSD needs an argmax-to-frequency read; no op converts the pairs to a scalar

missing_ops.need: a mask argument (or a masked variant) for watersheds_marker
missing_ops.why: the flood assigns background pixels to the nearest marker, so region areas after a watershed split are wrong unless the mask is applied by another op (blob_split does that, but only with distance-map seeds)

missing_ops.need: PPF / surface-based matching: find a CAD model's 6-DoF pose in a scene cloud (HALCON find_surface_model)
missing_ops.why: no point-pair-feature or surface-model matching op exists in OP_GRAPH or docs/ops (only ICP / GICP / FPFH / SHOT / spin registration)

missing_ops.need: threshold a grey voxel volume to a binary voxel volume (voxel -> voxel)
missing_ops.why: no explicit volume threshold op; vol_label thresholds implicitly at 0.5 (fixed), and region_props / label_components binarise with astype(bool) (every nonzero voxel is foreground)

missing_ops.need: keypoints (row, col) <-> (u = col, v = row) swap
missing_ops.why: the keypoints sort carries both conventions (calib.project_3d_point returns (row, col); pnp3d.dlt_pose / pnp_ransac expect (u, v)) and no op converts between them

missing_ops.need: TDOA (s) + microphone spacing -> source bearing angle (deg)
missing_ops.why: gcc_delay returns a delay; no op turns delay into a direction of arrival for a mic pair / array

missing_ops.need: a pair generator whose ledger form returns both frames (or seq<image> of 2)
missing_ops.why: fs.ledger.piv_synth_pair keeps only frame a (declared image), so a pair cannot start a chain; piv_synth_sequence -> piv_ensemble_correlate works, piv_cross_correlate needs a sample-built pair

missing_ops.need: spectrum peak picker: pairs (freqs, magnitude) -> measurement (peak frequency in Hz, sub-bin interpolated)
missing_ops.why: spectrum returns the typed pairs (freqs, |rfft|) but every peak op (find_peaks, peak_subbin) takes a signal; the FFT-peak chain spectrum -> peak cannot be typed, so the recipe reads peak_freq from signal_features instead (bin-quantised, no sub-bin refinement).

missing_ops.need: table field selector (table -> image / signal / scalar, by key)
missing_ops.why: dict-returning drive ops cannot feed their natural consumers: flow_from_depth_motion -> {u, v} cannot reach ttc_from_flow(u: image, v: image) or foe_from_flow; label_extent -> {width} cannot reach ttc_from_scale(w0, w1). A generic typed 'get field' op would close all of these.

missing_ops.need: voxel -> voxel grey threshold (the ledger twin of the registry's vol_threshold)
missing_ops.why: vol_threshold exists (2-D registry, sort 'volume', a = absolute level) and the volume-sorted chain vol_threshold -> vol_count runs; but the ledger's voxel chain (vol_label, regionprops3d, skeletonize_vol) takes 'voxel', and no op turns a grey voxel volume into a binary one at a chosen level, so threshold -> label / measure in 3-D still has a type cut between 'volume' and 'voxel'

failed_attempts.recipe: 3D — object pose from known 3-D points and their image (PnP)
failed_attempts.error: no exception; project_3d_point gives (row, col), dlt_pose reads (u, v) -> mirrored pose t = (-0.565, 0.61, 3.21) instead of (0.1, -0.05, 3.0)

failed_attempts.recipe: Measure — rotation angle of a part from matched 2-D points
failed_attempts.error: no exception; vector_to_rigid returns a 2-D homogeneous 3x3 [[c,-s,tx],[s,c,ty],[0,0,1]] while matrix_to_angle reads a rotation in axes (1, 2) (atan2(R[2,1], R[1,1])) -> 0.0 deg for a 20 deg rotation; matrix_to_rot_scale raises 'matrix: must be (2, 2); got (3, 3)'
fs.ledger.piv_synth_pair returns only frame a (64, 64); frame b and the truth are dropped, so piv_cross_correlate(a, b) has no b in the chain
paraxial_trace: expected the dict returned by lens_system(); thick_lens returns its own EFL table
ValueError movie has a negative entry; the default model needs one ON/OFF half (onoff[:, :n]) which a chain cannot slice — used model='hr' instead

failed_attempts.recipe: Sense — TTC from optical flow (flow_from_depth_motion -> ttc_from_flow)
failed_attempts.error: flow_from_depth_motion outputs table {u, v, valid, depth1}; ttc_from_flow inputs ['image', 'image'] — no op selects a table field as an image. Via the ledger too: fs.ledger.ttc_from_flow(flow_table, dt=0.1) -> TypeError: missing 1 required positional argument: 'v'

failed_attempts.recipe: Sense — TTC from apparent size growth (label_extent -> ttc_from_scale)
failed_attempts.error: label_extent outputs table {width, height, ...}; ttc_from_scale is declared a generator (inputs []) taking w0, w1 as scalar keywords. Via the ledger: fs.ledger.ttc_from_scale(extent_table, dt=0.1) -> TypeError: missing 1 required positional argument: 'w1'

failed_attempts.recipe: Sense — FFT peak frequency (spectrum -> find_peaks -> peak_subbin)
failed_attempts.error: spectrum outputs pairs (freqs, magnitude); find_peaks / peak_subbin input 'signal' — type cut at stage 2. Via the ledger: fs.ledger.find_peaks(spectrum(...)) -> ValueError: expected a 1-D signal ..., got shape (129, 2)

failed_attempts.recipe: contour -> from_xld -> elliptic_fourier (EFD of a sub-pixel contour)
failed_attempts.error: opsshape2d declares from_xld inputs ['table'], but the function requires the XLD contour dict {'shape', 'cs'} and refuses a table: fs.ledger.from_xld([[1, 2], [3, 4]]) -> ValueError: from_xld: contour must be an XLD contour dict with key 'cs', got list. The registry contour producers (threshold_sub_pix, edges_sub_pix) output 'contour', so contour -> from_xld is a type cut although the call works; the declaration should be ['contour']
